title: Intermediate Python

category.name: Python
category.description: Learn Python from your first line of code to data and automation.

short_description: Write cleaner, more powerful Python: comprehensions, classes, generators, decorators and tests.
description: You know the basics; now write Python like a professional. This course covers the tools experienced developers use every day: comprehensions and lambdas, your own modules and packages, virtual environments, object-oriented programming, iterators and generators, decorators, and testing your code.
